question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2017?
text: Alice got married on May 30th, 2014. Alice files a joint return with her spouse for 2017 and they take the standard deduction. Alice's gross income for the year 2017 is $103272 while her spouse had no income. Alice has paid $3200 to her brother Bob for work done from Feb 1st, 2017 to Sep 2nd, 2017, in Baltimore, Maryland, USA.
